editorial:
Imagine a hotel handyman who tells wild bedtime stories to his niece and nephew, only to wake up and find those silly tales are actually happening around him. That is the fun ride of this family comedy. Adam Sandler plays Skeeter Bronson, a guy stuck fixing things while dreaming of running the hotel. His stories start as goofy entertainment, but soon cowboys, knights, and space heroes seem to follow him into real life. The movie mixes fantasy, laughs, and a little romance, so it feels like a playful escape for kids and adults who want something light.

The best part is watching Skeeter react to each ridiculous twist, with help from his sister and a friendly teacher. The pacing stays quick, the jokes are broad, and the special effects are colorful without being too scary. It is not deep, and some gags repeat, but the heart is warm. If you want a cozy movie night, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray. It is a solid pick for families.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Skeeter realizes the stories are shaping real events, so he uses that power to help his family and stop the hotel from being sold. The villain is exposed, Skeeter proves he deserves to run the hotel, and he gets the girl. The last twist shows the bedtime stories were not just imagination; they became real because of the kids' belief, leaving Skeeter with a happier life and a new family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family comedies with fantasy twists and silly adventure.
